description: This file defines a Java interface 'FileGet' that declares methods for retrieving static content files from a Content Management System (CMS), including fetching individual files, filenames, and lists of files based on content type.

classes.name: FileGet
classes.description: A Java interface for retrieving static content files from the CMS, defining methods to get files, filenames, and lists of files.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Retrieves a specific content file based on the merchant store code, content type, and content name.

methods.name: getFileNames
methods.description: Retrieves a list of filenames for the specified merchant store and content type.

methods.name: getFiles
methods.description: Retrieves a list of content files for the specified merchant store and content type.
